_note: Resonances (designs/zenith_adventure.md 7.7). `tags` are the archetype and subtheme ids a Resonance serves; the Shrine offers two whose tags meet the run's starter. `style` ones carry a penalty. `rules` are the keys DuelEngine reads; `effect` and `penalty` are the sentences on screen.

resonances.name: Iron Resolve
resonances.effect: Your Strikes read the Strike Table one band higher, up to the top band.

resonances.name: Ready Channel
resonances.effect: The first Art you perform each Combat costs no Energy.

resonances.name: Steady Flame
resonances.effect: When you ascend, you keep your Drills in play.

resonances.name: Rising Ash
resonances.effect: When you ascend, put the top 3 cards of your discard pile on the bottom of your Life Deck.

resonances.name: Spoils of Ruin
resonances.effect: Whenever you make your opponent discard a Drill, Ally or Non-Combat card in play, gain 2 Energy stages.

resonances.name: Deep Well
resonances.effect: Power Up gains 1 more Energy stage.

resonances.name: Open Hand
resonances.effect: Draw 1 more card in every draw step.

resonances.name: First Stone
resonances.effect: At the start of each duel you may search your Life Deck for a Drill and put it into play. Your opponent cannot discard it.

resonances.name: Warband
resonances.effect: Your Strikes do 1 more stage for each Ally you have in play.

resonances.name: Sealwright's Patience
resonances.effect: Your Seals cannot be captured the turn they are placed, and placing one draws you a card.

resonances.name: Braced Stance
resonances.effect: The first attack against you each Combat does 1 fewer wound and 2 fewer stages.

resonances.name: Glass Cannon
resonances.penalty: Attacks against you do 1 more wound.

resonances.name: Patient Tide
resonances.effect: You open each duel at your highest Energy stage.
resonances.penalty: You cannot declare Combat on your first turn.
